english.note: Use this when two things correspond, match, or tally, often negated as 對唔上.
Use this when facts or information are consistent and make sense together.

examples.english: These two sets of figures agree.
examples.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 fan6 sou3 deoi3 dak1 soeng6

examples.english: The timing seems to track with the record.
examples.traditional: 呢個時間同記錄對得上。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan1 tung4 gei3 luk6 deoi3 dak1 soeng6
